traits.name: Plaguesense
traits.text: A leukodaemon senses any creature with a disease, and it knows the type and current stage of all diseases carried by any creature within range.

traits.name: Infectious Aura
traits.text: (aura, disease); 30 feet. Leukodaemons radiate infection. All creatures within 30 feet of a leukodaemon take a –2 status penalty to saves against disease effects. If a creature within range contracts or progresses a disease, all adjacent creatures are exposed to the same disease, at the same DC.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (evocation, divine); The leukodaemon exhales a cloud of corpse-bloated, biting black flies in a 20-foot cone. Creatures within the cone take 4d8 (4d8) piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save) A creature that fails the save becomes sickened 1 (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).

traits.name: Daemonic Pestilence
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier (1 day) Stage 2 drained 1 (1 day) Stage 3 drained 2 (1 day) Stage 4 drained 2 (1 day) Stage 5 drained 3 (1 week) Stage 6 dead. (null)

traits.name: Quicken Pestilence
traits.text: ⬻ (divine, manipulate, necromancy); The leukodaemon coaxes a disease into full bloom. It chooses a target in its aura of pestilence that's currently affected by a disease. That creature must attempt a Fortitude save against the disease as if the interval for the disease's current stage had passed.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +21 (disease, evil, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d12+9 (2d12+9) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and daemonic pestilence

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +21 (agile, disease, evil, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+9 (2d8+9) slashing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and daemonic pestilence

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ composite longbow +21 (deadly 1d10, disease, evil, magical, propulsive, range increment 100 feet, reload 0, volley 30 feet); Damage 2d8+9 (2d8+9) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and Daemonic Pestilence
